import sys
from collections import Counter
w=sys.stdin.read().split()
if len(w)>=2:
 s,t=w[0],w[1];need=Counter(t);missing=len(t);l=0;best=len(s)+1
 for r,ch in enumerate(s):
  if need[ch]>0: missing-=1

   if need[s[l]]>0: missing+=1

title: Edmonds-Karp Maximum S-T Flow
statement: Given V, E, source S, sink T, and E directed edges (u, v, cap), print the maximum flow from S to T.
referenceSolution:
import sys
from collections import deque
d=[int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
if d:
 v,e,s,t=d[0],d[1],d[2],d[3];cap=[[0]*v for _ in range(v)]
 for i in range(e): cap[d[4+3*i]][d[5+3*i]]+=d[6+3*i]
 flow=0
 while True:
  par=[-1]*v;par[s]=s;q=deque([(s,10**15)])
  pushed=0
  while q:
   u,f=q.popleft()
   if u==t: pushed=f;break
   for w in range(v):
    if par[w]==-1 and cap[u][w]>0: par[w]=u;q.append((w,min(f,cap[u][w])))
  if not pushed: break
  flow+=pushed;cur=t
  while cur!=s: p=par[cur];cap[p][cur]-=pushed;cap[cur][p]+=pushed;cur=p
 print(flow)

referenceSolution: const fs=require('fs');const d=fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);const cap=d[0];const reqs=d.slice(1);const cache=new Map();let miss=0;for(const x of reqs){if(cache.has(x)){cache.delete(x);cache.set(x,1);}else{miss++;if(cache.size>=cap)cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);cache.set(x,1);}}console.log(miss);

title: C Floyd-Warshall Shortest Path Query
statement: Read V, E, source S, target T, and E directed weighted edges (u, v, w); print shortest distance from S to T or -1.
referenceSolution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){int v,e,s,t;if(scanf("%d %d %d %d",&v,&e,&s,&t)!=4)return 0;long long g[50][50],INF=1e15;for(int i=0;i<v;i++)for(int j=0;j<v;j++)g[i][j]=(i==j?0:INF);for(int i=0;i<e;i++){int u,w;long long c;scanf("%d %d %lld",&u,&w,&c);if(c<g[u][w])g[u][w]=c;}for(int k=0;k<v;k++)for(int i=0;i<v;i++)for(int j=0;j<v;j++)if(g[i][k]+g[k][j]<g[i][j])g[i][j]=g[i][k]+g[k][j];printf("%lld\n",g[s][t]>=INF?-1:g[s][t]);return 0;}

title: C 0/1 Knapsack DP
statement: Read N items, capacity W, and N pairs (weight, value); print maximum knapsack value.
referenceSolution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){int n,w;if(scanf("%d %d",&n,&w)!=2)return 0;long long dp[1001]={0};for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int wt,val;scanf("%d %d",&wt,&val);for(int c=w;c>=wt;c--)if(dp[c-wt]+val>dp[c])dp[c]=dp[c-wt]+val;}printf("%lld\n",dp[w]);return 0;}

if not s or s[0]=='0': print(0)
else:
 p2,p1=1,1

  cur=0
